cd /app && cat > parsing/html/writer_test.go <<'EOF' package html_test import ( "testing" "github.com/tomwright/dasel/v3/model" "github.com/tomwright/dasel/v3/parsing" "github.com/tomwright/dasel/v3/parsing/html" ) func writeHTML(t *testing.T, value *model.Value, compact bool) string { t.Helper() opts := parsing.DefaultWriterOptions() opts.Compact = compact w, err := html.HTML.NewWriter(opts) if err != nil { t.Fatalf("unexpected error creating writer: %s", err) } out, err := w.Write(value) if err != nil { t.Fatalf("unexpected error writing HTML: %s", err) } return string(out) } func TestHtmlWriter_Write(t *testing.T) { t.Run("renders element map directly", func(t *testing.T) { body := model.NewMapValue() div := model.NewMapValue() _ = div.SetMapKey("-class", model.NewStringValue("box")) _ = div.SetMapKey("p", model.NewStringValue("hi")) _ = body.SetMapKey("div", div) root := model.NewMapValue() _ = root.SetMapKey("body", body) got := writeHTML(t, root, false) expected := `

hi

` if got != expected { t.Fatalf("Expected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", expected, got) } }) t.Run("void elements are self-closing", func(t *testing.T) { body := model.NewMapValue() _ = body.SetMapKey("br", model.NewStringValue("")) input := model.NewMapValue() _ = input.SetMapKey("-disabled", model.NewStringValue("")) _ = body.SetMapKey("input", input) root := model.NewMapValue() _ = root.SetMapKey("body", body) got := writeHTML(t, root, false) expected := `
` if got != expected { t.Fatalf("Expected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", expected, got) } }) t.Run("escapes text and attributes", func(t *testing.T) { div := model.NewMapValue() _ = div.SetMapKey("-title", model.NewStringValue(`a "quoted" & b`)) _ = div.SetMapKey("#text", model.NewStringValue("a & b < c")) root := model.NewMapValue() _ = root.SetMapKey("div", div) got := writeHTML(t, root, false) expected := `
a & b < c
` if got != expected { t.Fatalf("Expected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", expected, got) } }) t.Run("raw text is not escaped", func(t *testing.T) { root := model.NewMapValue() _ = root.SetMapKey("script", model.NewStringValue(`if (a < b && c > d) { x = "&"; }`)) got := writeHTML(t, root, false) expected := ` ` if got != expected { t.Fatalf("Expected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", expected, got) } }) t.Run("compact mode", func(t *testing.T) { body := model.NewMapValue() div := model.NewMapValue() _ = div.SetMapKey("p", model.NewStringValue("hi")) _ = body.SetMapKey("div", div) _ = body.SetMapKey("br", model.NewStringValue("")) root := model.NewMapValue() _ = root.SetMapKey("body", body) got := writeHTML(t, root, true) expected := `

hi


` if got != expected { t.Fatalf("Expected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", expected, got) } }) t.Run("writes structured node", func(t *testing.T) { title := model.NewMapValue() _ = title.SetMapKey("tag", model.NewStringValue("title")) _ = title.SetMapKey("attrs", model.NewMapValue()) _ = title.SetMapKey("text", model.NewStringValue("T")) _ = title.SetMapKey("children", model.NewSliceValue()) head := model.NewMapValue() _ = head.SetMapKey("tag", model.NewStringValue("head")) _ = head.SetMapKey("attrs", model.NewMapValue()) _ = head.SetMapKey("text", model.NewStringValue("")) titleChildren := model.NewSliceValue() _ = titleChildren.Append(title) _ = head.SetMapKey("children", titleChildren) p := model.NewMapValue() _ = p.SetMapKey("tag", model.NewStringValue("p")) attrs := model.NewMapValue() _ = attrs.SetMapKey("class", model.NewStringValue("x")) _ = p.SetMapKey("attrs", attrs) _ = p.SetMapKey("text", model.NewStringValue("Hi")) _ = p.SetMapKey("children", model.NewSliceValue()) body := model.NewMapValue() _ = body.SetMapKey("tag", model.NewStringValue("body")) _ = body.SetMapKey("attrs", model.NewMapValue()) _ = body.SetMapKey("text", model.NewStringValue("")) bodyChildren := model.NewSliceValue() _ = bodyChildren.Append(p) _ = body.SetMapKey("children", bodyChildren) root := model.NewMapValue() _ = root.SetMapKey("tag", model.NewStringValue("html")) rootAttrs := model.NewMapValue() _ = rootAttrs.SetMapKey("lang", model.NewStringValue("en")) _ = root.SetMapKey("attrs", rootAttrs) _ = root.SetMapKey("text", model.NewStringValue("")) rootChildren := model.NewSliceValue() _ = rootChildren.Append(head) _ = rootChildren.Append(body) _ = root.SetMapKey("children", rootChildren) got := writeHTML(t, root, false) expected := ` T

Hi

` if got != expected { t.Fatalf("Expected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", expected, got) } }) } EOF go test ./parsing/html/ -v 2>&1 | tail -40
